description: ODC: SQL written in the SQL Server dialect (TOP, ISNULL, GETDATE). The ODC Studio accepts it (the TrueChange checks entities, attributes and parameters, not the dialect) and the PostgreSQL of ODC refuses it when executing the query. The SQL preflight of the ODC lane refuses before loading the model, with op, line and the PostgreSQL replacement. Runs in OdcJobTests.JobFailsWithTheTeachingMessageInTheOdcLane.
expectError: op #0 (SQL in logic action 'WfCov_Tasks_TopSql' get 'ReadTasks', line 1) [SQL_INVALID]: TOP does not exist in PostgreSQL (ODC); remove it and end the query with LIMIT n
op #0 (SQL in logic action 'WfCov_Tasks_TopSql' get 'ReadTasks', line 2) [SQL_INVALID]: ISNULL() is SQL Server; ODC runs SQL on PostgreSQL, which has no such function: use COALESCE(x, fallback)
op #0 (SQL in logic action 'WfCov_Tasks_TopSql' get 'ReadTasks', line 3) [SQL_INVALID]: GETDATE() is SQL Server; ODC runs SQL on PostgreSQL, which has no such function: use NOW() or CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

actions.name: WfCov_Tasks_TopSql
actions.description: Prova negativa: consulta SQL em dialeto SQL Server na faixa ODC

steps.statement:
SELECT TOP 10 {WfCovTask}.* FROM {WfCovTask}
WHERE ISNULL({WfCovTask}.[Title], '') <> ''
  AND {WfCovTask}.[DueOn] <= GETDATE()
ORDER BY {WfCovTask}.[DueOn]
